captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of a two-piece matching friendship heart charm. The heart is split vertically down the center with a jagged, interlocking puzzle-like seam, dividing it into a left section and a right section. Each half is a flat, extruded plate with a small circular mounting loop at the outer top corner for attaching to a necklace or keychain. When placed together, the two halves form a complete, classic heart shape.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, two-piece interlocking friendship heart charm in OpenSCAD. The design should allow the user to adjust the overall heart size, select custom initials for each half using an external font library, and split the heart into distinct left and right halves with a jagged puzzle cut, complete with integrated hanging loops.
captions.factory: The script defines a 2D heart shape using two translated circles and a rotated square. It splits the heart into left and right sections by applying a boolean difference with custom-defined jagged polygon masks ('leftSquare' and 'rightSquare'). These sections are extruded using linear_extrude with a defined thickness. Finally, customizable text initials are placed on each half using the write library, and two small ring hangers are constructed using nested cylinders and positioned at the top lobes of each heart half.
